decision: build a lightweight Go photo API exposing the Immich REST subset instead of running full Immich or querying Synology Photos API
why: Immich uses gigabytes of RAM for ML and Postgres, while Synology Photos API is unofficial and caps thumbnails around 1280px
result: MMM-ImmichSlideShow works without custom frontend code and NAS photos stay mounted read-only

decision: compile photo-api with CGO_ENABLED=0 using modernc.org/sqlite and shell out to heif-convert only for uncached HEIC files
why: avoids CGO cross-compile and memory issues across amd64 and arm64 Synology NAS models while caching 2K JPEGs on disk
result: multi-stage Docker image builds cleanly with libheif-examples and bundled GeoNames cities1000

decision: pivot from separate digital-photoframe and server-photo-api repos to one unified self-host-digital-photo-frame repo
why: keeps Synology Docker Compose stack and Raspberry Pi client in one repo while leaving legacy digital-photoframe untouched as reference
result: created henrynvn09/self-host-digital-photo-frame and published spec #1 and tickets #2-#7

decision: implement photo-api incremental scanner, SQLite index, offline GeoNames lookup, 1GB LRU preview cache, and pinned MagicMirror image
why: delivers anniversary, memory, random, and date-range search modes without ML smart search
result: Go -race integration tests and non-root 1026:100 Docker smoke test pass

decision: fix two-axis code review findings including pinned module SHAs, albumName field, ?day=&month= memories query, CreateDate fallback, pure-Go HEIC EXIF parsing, and smoke-test.sh
why: two-axis review caught schema mismatches with MMM-ImmichSlideShow and floating git clones in magicmirror/Dockerfile
result: all review findings resolved, tests green, tickets #2-#7 closed

decision: reorganize repository into top-level server/ and client/ folders with standalone setup READMEs
why: separates Synology NAS Container Manager deployment from Raspberry Pi client setup cleanly
result: server/docker-compose.yml and Go test suite pass under new paths

decision: set CMD ["npm", "run", "server"] and mount custom.css inside /opt/magic_mirror/config/ in magicmirror container
why: live Docker Compose test showed karsten13/magicmirror:v2.38.0 defaulted to Electron/Wayland and crashed on headless server startup
result: magicmirror container starts cleanly in headless server-only mode at ~75 MiB RAM

decision: include originalPath in Immich asset JSON payload returned by photo-api
why: live browser check at http://localhost:8036 was blank because MMM-ImmichSlideShow filters assets via checkValidImageFileExtension(element.originalPath)
result: slideshow renders photos and metadata overlays live at http://localhost:8036

decision: change default preview bounding box from 2560x1440 to 2560x2560
why: the 27-inch 2K monitor is mounted vertically in portrait 1440x2560, and a 1440 height cap shrunk portrait photos
result: both portrait 1440x2560 and landscape 2560x1440 previews stay native 2K sharp

decision: pin MMM-ImmichSlideShow to original commit 955c2538ccdd5b9702119826edcda549db937f55 instead of upstream HEAD
why: upstream HEAD changed showBlurredImageForBlackBars rendering and degraded the blurred background look compared to the original setup
result: blurred background bars match the reference wedding screenshot

decision: add optional PREBAKE_BLUR toggle (default false, FRAME_WIDTH=1440, FRAME_HEIGHT=2560) to photo-api
why: allows offloading blurred portrait background compositing to the Synology NAS if desired while keeping client CSS blur as default
result: TestPrebakeBlurToggle passes in Go -race test suite

decision: replace npm + node + Electron on the 1GB Raspberry Pi 4 client with a native WebKitGTK kiosk viewer and Bookworm X11 DPMS display power control
why: Electron plus npm consumed ~500 MB of the Pi 4's 948 MB ARM RAM causing swap lag, and Bookworm KMS deprecates vcgencmd display_power
evidence: commit dcd555b, client/kiosk.py, client/pir.py, issue #9, issue #10
result: single-process WebKit2 DOCUMENT_VIEWER kiosk and xset dpms power control verified

decision: delete 11 legacy client scripts (2,916 lines) and consolidate into install.sh, frame.sh, kiosk.py, and pir.py
why: removes redundant Pi 3B Electron wrapper scripts and 800-line interactive installer
result: client reduced to 4 executable scripts and a 3-step README

decision: remove Chromium/Electron fallbacks in client/frame.sh and fail fast when WebKitGTK is missing
why: ensures a missing or broken WebKitGTK install on the Pi 4 surfaces immediately instead of silently running a heavier browser
result: ./client/frame.sh browser exits with status 1 and explicit error when WebKit2 is absent; tickets #9-#11 closed
